user_requested_changes: M388: allow an open-ended savings goal with no fixed target amount and no mandatory budget, preserve old target goals and wallet accounting; avoid false 0-percent completion and allow editing the goal.

M389: Goals plus opens new goal, duplicate existing goal, and unlimited savings; Recurring plus opens new recurring or duplicate existing recurring. Duplication uses a new ID, preserves original and does not copy goal savings or old linked-goal ID.
M390: tapping existing counted corner badge on both Home and Transactions opens the exact preserved receipt gallery without modifying saved attachment paths or removing details access.
M388-M390: update only regression tests whose old expected results contradict the newly user-approved functionality; track all 42 acceptance cases independently.
M388: legacy goal regression must verify goal creation with open-ended zero-target still never debits spendable cash or skips source-bound persistence.

M391: after M274 Android emulator precompile failed on truncated Android NDK 28.2.13676358 zip, perform bounded retries of same pinned NDK with explicit fail-closed version validation, without skipping emulator UI checks.
M392: every saved budget has collapsed-by-default expandable details, a clearly visible switch, bigger suggested templates, an arrow for template disclosure, and non-overlapping create spacing.
M393: each goal and recurring transaction has collapsed Quick actions (edit/delete/activate); goal pause leaves saved balance untouched and linked recurrence inactive. Existing goals default active.
M394: preserve zero-target savings through non-negative legacy and experimental encrypted finance validation and cloud allowlist; never accept negative targets or silently activate SQLCipher.
M395: search and visible scrollbars in Goals and Recurring; presentation-only filters must never alter financial entries.
M396: new or newly dated goal due never silently creates a recurring obligation; ask the user with explicit Not now / Link due date options while keeping ledger and savings unchanged.
M397: remove unnecessary optional/encryption jargon from the savings date picker and original SMS title while retaining genuine encrypted-vault safety notices.

M398-M402: fix previously approved budget directory reopen and own-budget filters, ensure bounded calendars and concise UI copy, show monthly budget count and month navigation, and use centered blurred dropdowns in the user-approved locations.
M403: support independent activation and quick actions on main/subcategories without deleting historical entries or changing finance ledger.
M406: repair Drift test API errors without weakening assertions, and expand M385 scope only to exact PR changed hunks while preserving protected code outside them.

M408: repair six actual failing assertions without removing any financial or security test: month navigation, recurring durable writes, active category validation, concise bank SMS title, StateError rollback, and paused goal due behavior.

M409: fix the failed M274 Android UI startup caused by VM-service disconnect and an offline emulator during a redundant post-boot Gradle build. Reuse the exact precompiled integration debug APK with a real Flutter drive integration driver, stop idle Gradle daemons before boot, preserve real tap assertions and fail-closed diagnostics.

M410: implement safe incremental CI recovery: retry exactly one failed Android emulator CI job on the same SHA only when logs prove transient infrastructure failure; cap to one retry, disallow failing application assertions or stale PR heads, never skip protected financial/security checks or final full-main certification.

M411: repair real red Firestore security CI dependency install: pin stable Firebase JS SDK and security emulator versions, override the unavailable @firebase/firestore 4.19.1 tarball to published 4.19.0, use Node 24.12.0 for engine compatibility, preserve all security assertion tests and do not fake green.

M412: final incremental PR CI implementation: compare the exact before-to-after SHA pair of each PR synchronize event to only run impacted scope-specific test jobs; keep always-on mandatory production finance/security and complete main verification; on unknown diff, base ancestry, event, or path list run all (fail-open); do not silently skip on code changes; no modifications to app logic or user data.

M416: Saudi-only release disables first-run location country detection, country/dialect selection and the app-wide display currency setting while preserving the independent Tools currency converter, live FX conversions, gold FX action, Global implementation and old preferences.
M416: disable creating a transaction by OCR/image/receipt while keeping existing receipt attachments and manual transactions intact.

M416: Ask Waffra is a no-chat predefined question list based only on verified recorded income, expenses, categories and explicitly linked standalone budgets, with Clear returning to the question list. No Qwen requirement or network.
M416: pasted/shared bank SMS is parsed using the conservative local Saudi parser, never Qwen, with no foreign-currency-as-SAR auto-post; the user still confirms saved transactions.
M416: do not alter existing financial history, SQLCipher activation, Google login, or saved Global preferences during Saudi-only rollout; preserve AR/EN app language for Saudi users.

M416 QA: maintain the dormant Global unit tests but update Saudi-production expectations of country, locale and currency; remove generated Android coarse-location permission in Saudi builds, with explicit Global opt-in script mode.

M416 owner correction (Nov 2): restore original Tools currency converter in full; it was never approved for disabling. Keep only the app base currency/country and bank-SMS foreign FX-preview restrictions separate.

M416 owner correction: both Google and non-Google signup, sign-in and profile must use a 10-digit Saudi 05XXXXXXXX national mobile input with no flags, +966 label or selectable country. Preserve existing stored Saudi +966 Google records and never silently migrate old non-Saudi numbers.

M416 regression update: enforce Saudi SAR-only app display, original finance values, offline deterministic bank-SMS draft review, disabled receipt-image transaction import, and independent optional Qwen consent; all unrelated tests remain active.
